observations: Blue motorcycle with a black seat and silver engine components.
The front headlight assembly is a modified LED unit.
The engine is fitted with a large, custom-style front radiator shroud.
The exhaust pipe is a polished chrome aftermarket unit.
The motorcycle is parked on a dirt surface.
A Nigerian license plate is visible on the rear.
The brand name 'MUONE' is visible on the rear seat support in photo 2.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and running.

risks.risk: The electrical system (headlight, indicators) may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the headlight and turn signals working.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not be street legal due to missing or damaged registration documents.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the vehicle registration document.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the headlight and turn signals working.
Photo of the vehicle registration document.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
